rationale: The Court is most likely to issue a narrow Roberts opinion reversing on the ground that the district court failed to rigorously disentangle race from a plausible partisan objective under Cromartie/Cooper and Abbott’s presumption of good faith. Separate writings are most likely from Thomas (to press broader Equal Protection limits) and from Sotomayor/Jackson (to emphasize clear-error deference and the sufficiency of circumstantial proof of race-driven line drawing).
